sEn: We propose proximal policy optimization (PPO), a new family of policy gradient methods that is simpler, more general, and has better sample complexity than trust region policy optimization.
sZh: 我们提出了一种新的策略梯度方法家族——近端策略优化（PPO），它比信任区域策略优化更简单、更通用，且样本复杂度更低。
absEn: We propose a new family of policy gradient methods for reinforcement learning, which alternate between sampling data through interaction with the environment, and optimizing a "surrogate" objective function using stochastic gradient ascent. Whereas standard policy gradient methods perform one gradient update per data sample, we propose a novel objective function that enables multiple epochs of minibatch updates. The new methods, which we call proximal policy optimization (PPO), have some of the benefits of trust region policy optimization (TRPO), but they are much simpler to implement, more general, and have better sample complexity (empirically). Our experiments test PPO on a collection of benchmark tasks, including simulated robotic locomotion and Atari game playing, and we show that PPO outperforms other online policy gradient methods, and overall strikes a favorable balance between sample complexity, simplicity, and wall-time.
absZh: 我们提出了一系列新的用于强化学习的策略梯度方法，这些方法通过在环境中交互采样数据，然后使用随机梯度上升优化一个“替代”目标函数。标准策略梯度方法每个数据样本只进行一次梯度更新，而我们提出的新目标函数支持多次小批量更新。这种新方法被称为近端策略优化（PPO），它继承了信任区域策略优化（TRPO）的一些优点，但实现起来更简单、更通用，且经验上样本复杂度更低。我们在包括模拟机器人运动和Atari游戏在内的基准任务上测试了PPO，结果表明PPO优于其他在线策略梯度方法，并在样本复杂度、简洁性和实际运行时间之间取得了良好的平衡。

contrib.en: PPO achieves stability and reliability similar to TRPO but is simpler and more general.

contrib.en: Provides better sample complexity and wall-time efficiency compared to prior methods.

limits.en: Clipping hyperparameter ε requires tuning for different tasks.

paras.en: Proximal Policy Optimization Algorithms John Schulman, Filip Wolski, Prafulla Dhariwal, Alec Radford, Oleg Klimov OpenAI {joschu, filip, prafulla, alec, oleg}@openai.com Abstract We propose a new family of policy gradient methods for reinforcement learning, which alternate between sampling data through interaction with the environment, and optimizing a "surrogate" objective function using stochastic gradient ascent. Whereas standard policy gradient methods perform one gradient update per data sample, we propose a novel objective function that enables multiple epochs of minibatch updates. The new methods, which we call proximal policy optimization (PPO), have some of the benefits of trust region policy optimization (TRPO), but they are much simpler to implement, more general, and have better sample complexity (empirically). Our experiments test PPO on a collection of benchmark tasks, including simulated robotic locomotion and Atari game playing, and we show that PPO outperforms other online policy gradient methods, and overall strikes a favorable balance between sample complexity, simplicity, and wall-time.
paras.zh: 近端策略优化算法  John Schulman, Filip Wolski, Prafulla Dhariwal, Alec Radford, Oleg Klimov OpenAI {joschu, filip, prafulla, alec, oleg}@openai.com 摘要 我们提出了一类新的用于强化学习的策略梯度方法，这些方法在通过与环境交互采样数据和利用随机梯度上升优化一个“代理”目标函数之间交替。标准的策略梯度方法对每个数据样本执行一次梯度更新，而我们提出了一种新颖的目标函数，可以进行多次小批量更新。这些新方法称为近端策略优化（PPO），具有信任域策略优化（TRPO）的一些优点，但实现更简单、更具通用性，并且具有更好的样本复杂度（实验上）。我们的实验在包括模拟机器人运动控制和Atari游戏等一系列基准任务上测试了PPO，结果表明PPO优于其他在线策略梯度方法，并在样本复杂度、简单性和运行时间之间取得了良好的平衡。

paras.en: In recent years, several different approaches have been proposed for reinforcement learning with neural network function approximators. The leading contenders are deep Q-learning [Mni+15], "vanilla" policy gradient methods [Mni+16], and trust region / natural policy gradient methods [Sch+15b]. However, there is room for improvement in developing a method that is scalable (to large models and parallel implementations), data efficient, and robust (i.e., successful on a variety of problems without hyperparameter tuning). Q-learning (with function approximation) fails on many simple problems1 and is poorly understood, vanilla policy gradient methods have poor data efficiency and robustness; and trust region policy optimization (TRPO) is relatively complicated, and is not compatible with architectures that include noise (such as dropout) or parameter sharing (between the policy and value function, or with auxiliary tasks). This paper seeks to improve the current state of affairs by introducing an algorithm that attains the data efficiency and reliable performance of TRPO, while using only first-order optimization. We propose a novel objective with clipped probability ratios, which forms a pessimistic estimate (i.e., lower bound) of the performance of the policy. To optimize policies, we alternate between sampling data from the policy and performing several epochs of optimization on the sampled data. Our experiments compare the performance of various different versions of the surrogate objective, and find that the version with the clipped probability ratios performs best. We also compare PPO to several previous algorithms from the literature. On continuous control tasks, it performs better than the algorithms we compare against. On Atari, it performs significantly better (in terms of sample complexity) than A2C and similarly to ACER though it is much simpler. 1
paras.zh: 近年来，已经提出了几种不同的使用神经网络函数逼近器的强化学习方法。主要竞争者是深度Q学习[Mni+15]、“普通”策略梯度方法[Mni+16]和信任域/自然策略梯度方法[Sch+15b]。然而，在开发一种可扩展（适用于大型模型和并行实现）、数据高效且稳健（即无需超参数调整即可在多种问题上成功）的方法方面，仍有改进空间。Q学习（使用函数逼近）在许多简单问题1上失败且理解不足，普通策略梯度方法数据效率和稳健性差；而信任域策略优化（TRPO）相对复杂，并且不兼容包含噪声（如dropout）或参数共享（在策略和值函数之间，或与辅助任务）的架构。本文旨在通过引入一种仅使用一阶优化就能达到TRPO的数据效率和可靠性能的算法来改善现状。我们提出了一种具有裁剪概率比的新颖目标函数，该目标函数形成策略性能的悲观估计（即下界）。为了优化策略，我们在从策略采样数据和对采样数据执行多个epoch的优化之间交替进行。我们的实验比较了代理目标函数的各种不同版本，发现带有裁剪概率比的版本性能最佳。我们还将PPO与文献中的几种先前算法进行了比较。在连续控制任务上，它的性能优于我们比较的算法。在Atari上，它的性能（在样本复杂度方面）显著优于A2C，与ACER相当，但更简单。1

paras.en: While DQN works well on game environments like the Arcade Learning Environment [Bel+15] with discrete action spaces, it has not been demonstrated to perform well on continuous control benchmarks such as those in OpenAI Gym [Bro+16] and described by Duan et al. [Dua+16].
paras.zh: 尽管DQN在具有离散动作空间的游戏环境（如Arcade Learning Environment [Bel+15]）中表现良好，但尚未证明它在连续控制基准（例如OpenAI Gym [Bro+16]和Duan等人描述的那些 [Dua+16]）上表现良好。

paras.en:
Policy gradient methods work by computing an estimator of the policy gradient and plugging it into a stochastic gradient ascent algorithm. The most commonly used gradient estimator has the form \( \hat{g} = \hat{\mathbb{E}}_t [ 
abla_	heta \log \pi_	heta(a_t|s_t) \hat{A}_t ] \) (1) where πθ is a stochastic policy and \\hat{A}_t\ is an estimator of the advantage function at timestep t. Here, the expectation \\hat{\mathbb{E}}_t [\cdot]\ indicates the empirical average over a finite batch of samples, in an algorithm that alternates between sampling and optimization. Implementations that use automatic differentiation software work by constructing an objective function whose gradient is the policy gradient estimator; the estimator \\hat{g}\ is obtained by differentiating the objective \L^{PG}(	heta) = \hat{\mathbb{E}}_t [ \log \pi_	heta(a_t|s_t) \hat{A}_t ]\ (2). While it is appealing to perform multiple steps of optimization on this loss \L^{PG}\ using the same trajectory, doing so is not well-justified, and empirically it often leads to destructively large policy updates (see Section 6.1; results are not shown but were similar or worse than the "no clipping or penalty" setting).
paras.zh:
策略梯度方法通过计算策略梯度的估计器并将其插入随机梯度上升算法来工作。最常用的梯度估计器具有形式：\( \hat{g} = \hat{\mathbb{E}}_t [ 
abla_	heta \log \pi_	heta(a_t|s_t) \hat{A}_t ] \) (1)，其中πθ是随机策略，\\hat{A}_t\是时间步t的优势函数估计器。这里，期望\\hat{\mathbb{E}}_t [\cdot]\表示在交替采样和优化的算法中，对有限批次样本的经验平均值。使用自动微分软件的实现通过构建一个目标函数来工作，该函数的梯度就是策略梯度估计器；估计器\\hat{g}\是通过微分目标函数\L^{PG}(	heta) = \hat{\mathbb{E}}_t [ \log \pi_	heta(a_t|s_t) \hat{A}_t ]\ (2)获得的。虽然使用同一条轨迹对这个损失\L^{PG}\进行多步优化很有吸引力，但这并不合理，并且经验上常常导致破坏性的大策略更新（参见第6.1节；结果未显示，但与“无裁剪或惩罚”设置相似或更差）。

paras.en: In TRPO [Sch+15b], an objective function (the "surrogate" objective) is maximized subject to a constraint on the size of the policy update. Specifically, \\max_{	heta} \hat{\mathbb{E}}_t \left[  rac{\pi_	heta(a_t|s_t)}{\pi_{	heta_{	ext{old}}}(a_t|s_t)} \hat{A}_t ight] \quad 	ext{s.t.} \quad \hat{\mathbb{E}}_t [ 	ext{KL}[ \pi_{	heta_{	ext{old}}}(\cdot|s_t), \pi_	heta(\cdot|s_t) ] ] \leq \delta\ (3).
paras.zh: 在TRPO [Sch+15b]中，目标函数（“代理”目标）在满足策略更新大小的约束下最大化。具体地，\\max_{	heta} \hat{\mathbb{E}}_t \left[  rac{\pi_	heta(a_t|s_t)}{\pi_{	heta_{	ext{old}}}(a_t|s_t)} \hat{A}_t ight] \quad 	ext{s.t.} \quad \hat{\mathbb{E}}_t [ 	ext{KL}[ \pi_{	heta_{	ext{old}}}(\cdot|s_t), \pi_	heta(\cdot|s_t) ] ] \leq \delta\ (3)。

paras.en: Here, \(θ_{old}\) is the vector of policy parameters before the update. This problem can efficiently be approximately solved using the conjugate gradient algorithm, after making a linear approximation to the objective and a quadratic approximation to the constraint. The theory justifying TRPO actually suggests using a penalty instead of a constraint, i.e., solving the unconstrained optimization problem \( \max_{θ} \hat{E}_t \left[ \frac{π_θ(a_t|s_t)}{π_{θ_{old}}(a_t|s_t)} \hat{A}_t - β \text{KL}[π_{θ_{old}}(·|s_t), π_θ(·|s_t)] \right] \) for some coefficient \(β\). This follows from the fact that a certain surrogate objective (which computes the max KL over states instead of the mean) forms a lower bound (i.e., a pessimistic bound) on the performance of the policy \(π\). TRPO uses a hard constraint rather than a penalty because it is hard to choose a single value of \(β\) that performs well across different problems—or even within a single problem, where the characteristics change over the course of learning. Hence, to achieve our goal of a first-order algorithm that emulates the monotonic improvement of TRPO, experiments show that it is not sufficient to simply choose a fixed penalty coefficient \(β\) and optimize the penalized objective Equation (5) with SGD; additional modifications are required.
paras.zh: 这里，\(θ_{old}\)是更新前的策略参数向量。通过对目标函数进行线性近似、对约束进行二次近似，该问题可以使用共轭梯度算法高效近似求解。实际上，支持TRPO的理论建议使用惩罚项代替约束，即求解无约束优化问题：\( \max_{θ} \hat{E}_t \left[ \frac{π_θ(a_t|s_t)}{π_{θ_{old}}(a_t|s_t)} \hat{A}_t - β \text{KL}[π_{θ_{old}}(·|s_t), π_θ(·|s_t)] \right] \) (5)，其中系数\(β\)为某个值。这是因为某个替代目标函数（计算状态上的最大KL而非均值）形成了策略\(π\)性能的下界（即悲观界）。TRPO使用硬约束而非惩罚项，因为很难选择一个单一的\(β\)值在不同问题中表现良好——甚至在同一问题中，随着学习过程特征变化也难以选择。因此，为了实现模拟TRPO单调改进的一阶算法，实验表明仅选择固定的惩罚系数\(β\)并通过SGD优化带惩罚的目标函数（公式5）是不够的，还需要额外的修改。

paras.en: Let \(r_t(θ)\) denote the probability ratio \(r_t(θ) = \frac{π_θ(a_t|s_t)}{π_{θ_{\text{old}}}(a_t|s_t)}\), so \(r(θ_{\text{old}}) = 1\). TRPO maximizes a “surrogate” objective \(L^{CPI}(θ) = \hat{E}_t \left[ \frac{π_θ(a_t|s_t)}{π_{θ_{\text{old}}}(a_t|s_t)} \hat{A}_t \right] = \hat{E}_t [ r_t(θ) \hat{A}_t ]\ (6). The superscript CPI refers to conservative policy iteration [KL02], where this objective was proposed. Without a constraint, maximization of \(L^{CPI}\) would lead to an excessively large policy update; hence, we now consider how to modify the objective, to penalize changes to the policy that move \(r_t(θ)\) away from 1. The main objective we propose is the following: \[ L^{CLIP}(θ) = \hat{E}_t \left[ \min( r_t(θ) \hat{A}_t, \text{clip}(r_t(θ), 1-ε, 1+ε) \hat{A}_t ) \right] \ (7)
paras.zh: 令 \(r_t(θ)\) 表示概率比 \(r_t(θ) = \frac{π_θ(a_t|s_t)}{π_{θ_{\text{old}}}(a_t|s_t)}\)，因此 \(r(θ_{\text{old}}) = 1\)。TRPO 最大化一个“替代”目标函数：\(L^{CPI}(θ) = \hat{E}_t \left[ \frac{π_θ(a_t|s_t)}{π_{θ_{\text{old}}}(a_t|s_t)} \hat{A}_t \right] = \hat{E}_t [ r_t(θ) \hat{A}_t ]\ (6)。上标 CPI 指保守策略迭代（conservative policy iteration）[KL02]，该目标函数由该文献提出。若不施加约束，最大化 \(L^{CPI}\) 会导致过大的策略更新；因此，我们现在考虑如何修改目标函数，以惩罚使 \(r_t(θ)\) 偏离 1 的策略变化。我们提出的主要目标函数如下：\[ L^{CLIP}(θ) = \hat{E}_t \left[ \min( r_t(θ) \hat{A}_t, \text{clip}(r_t(θ), 1-ε, 1+ε) \hat{A}_t ) \right] \ (7)

paras.en: where epsilon is a hyperparameter, say, \(ε = 0.2\). The motivation for this objective is as follows. The first term inside the min is \(L^{CPI}\). The second term, \(\text{clip}(r_t(θ), 1-ε, 1+ε) \hat{A}_t\), modifies the surrogate objective by clipping the probability ratio, which removes the incentive for moving \(r_t\) outside of the interval \([1-ε, 1+ε]\). Finally, we take the minimum of the clipped and unclipped objective, so the final objective is a lower bound (i.e., a pessimistic bound) on the unclipped objective. With this scheme, we only ignore the change in probability ratio when it would make the objective improve, and we include it when it makes the objective worse. Note that \(L^{CLIP}(θ) = L^{CPI}(θ)\) to first order around \(θ_{\text{old}}\) (i.e., where \(r=1\)), however, they become different as \(θ\) moves away from \(θ_{\text{old}}\). Figure 1 plots a single term (i.e., a single t) in \(L^{CLIP}\); note that the probability ratio \(r\) is clipped at \(1-ε\) or \(1+ε\) depending on whether the advantage is positive or negative.
paras.zh: 其中 epsilon 是一个超参数，例如 \(ε=0.2\)。该目标函数的动机如下：min 中的第一项是 \(L^{CPI}\)。第二项 \(\text{clip}(r_t(θ), 1-ε, 1+ε) \hat{A}_t\) 通过裁剪概率比来修改替代目标函数，从而消除了将 \(r_t\) 移出区间 \([1-ε, 1+ε]\) 的动机。最后，我们取裁剪目标与未裁剪目标的最小值，因此最终目标函数是未裁剪目标的下界（即悲观界）。采用此方案，我们仅在概率比的变化会改善目标函数时忽略该变化，而在其使目标函数变差时将其纳入。注意，在 \(θ_{\text{old}}\) 附近（即 \(r=1\) 处），\(L^{CLIP}(θ) = L^{CPI}(θ)\) 一阶相近，但随着 \(θ\) 远离 \(θ_{\text{old}}\)，它们变得不同。图1 绘制了 \(L^{CLIP}\) 中的单个项（即单个 t）；注意概率比 \(r\) 根据优势函数的正负被裁剪至 \(1-ε\) 或 \(1+ε\)。

paras.en: \( \hat{E}_t[\text{KL}_t] \) \( L^{CPI} = \hat{E}_t[r_t \hat{A}_t] \) \( \hat{E}_t[\text{clip}(r_t, 1-ε, 1+ε) \hat{A}_t] \) \( L^{CLIP} = \hat{E}_t[\min(r_t \hat{A}_t, \text{clip}(r_t, 1-ε, 1+ε) \hat{A}_t)] \
paras.zh: \( \hat{E}_t[\text{KL}_t] \) \( L^{CPI} = \hat{E}_t[r_t \hat{A}_t] \) \( \hat{E}_t[\text{clip}(r_t, 1-ε, 1+ε) \hat{A}_t] \) \( L^{CLIP} = \hat{E}_t[\min(r_t \hat{A}_t, \text{clip}(r_t, 1-ε, 1+ε) \hat{A}_t)] \

paras.en: Another approach, which can be used as an alternative to the clipped surrogate objective, or in addition to it, is to use a penalty on KL divergence, and to adapt the penalty coefficient so that we achieve some target value of the KL divergence \(d_{\text{targ}}\) each policy update. In our experiments, we found that the KL penalty performed worse than the clipped surrogate objective, however, we've included it here because it's an important baseline. In the simplest instantiation of this algorithm, we perform the following steps in each policy update: • Using several epochs of minibatch SGD, optimize the KL-penalized objective \( L^{KLPEN}(θ) = \hat{E}_t \left[ \frac{π_θ(a_t|s_t)}{π_{θ_{\text{old}}}(a_t|s_t)} \hat{A}_t - β \text{KL}[π_{θ_{\text{old}}}(·|s_t), π_θ(·|s_t)] \right] \
paras.zh: 另一种可以替代裁剪替代目标函数或作为其补充的方法是，使用KL散度惩罚，并自适应地调整惩罚系数，使得每次策略更新达到某个目标KL散度值 \(d_{\text{targ}}\)。在我们的实验中，我们发现KL惩罚的效果不如裁剪替代目标函数，但我们仍在此介绍，因为它是一个重要的基线。在该算法的最简单实例中，我们在每次策略更新中执行以下步骤：• 使用多个小批次SGD轮次，优化带KL惩罚的目标函数：\( L^{KLPEN}(θ) = \hat{E}_t \left[ \frac{π_θ(a_t|s_t)}{π_{θ_{\text{old}}}(a_t|s_t)} \hat{A}_t - β \text{KL}[π_{θ_{\text{old}}}(·|s_t), π_θ(·|s_t)] \right] \

paras.en: Compute d = \hat{E}_t [KL[\pi_{\theta_{\text{old}}}(\cdot | s_t), \pi_\theta(\cdot | s_t)]] - if d < d_{\text{targ}}/1.5, \beta \leftarrow \beta/2
paras.zh: 计算 d = \hat{E}_t [KL[\pi_{\theta_{\text{old}}}(\cdot | s_t), \pi_\theta(\cdot | s_t)]] - 若 d < d_{\text{targ}}/1.5，则 \beta \leftarrow \beta/2

paras.en: The updated \beta is used for the next policy update. With this scheme, we occasionally see policy updates where the KL divergence is significantly different from d_{\text{targ}}, however, these are rare, and \beta quickly adjusts. The parameters 1.5 and 2 above are chosen heuristically, but the algorithm is not very sensitive to them. The initial value of \beta is another hyperparameter but is not important in practice because the algorithm quickly adjusts it.
paras.zh: 更新后的 \beta 用于下一次策略更新。在这种方案下，我们偶尔会看到 KL 散度与 d_{\text{targ}} 显著不同的策略更新，但这很少见，且 \beta 会迅速调整。上述参数 1.5 和 2 是启发式选择的，但算法对它们并不十分敏感。\beta 的初始值是另一个超参数，但在实践中并不重要，因为算法会快速调整它。

paras.en: The surrogate losses from the previous sections can be computed and differentiated with a minor change to a typical policy gradient implementation. For implementations that use automatic differentiation, one simply constructs the loss \(L^{CLIP}\) or \(L^{KLPEN}\) instead of \(L^{PG}\), and one performs multiple steps of stochastic gradient ascent on this objective. Most techniques for computing variance-reduced advantage-function estimators make use a learned state-value function \(V(s)\); for example, generalized advantage estimation [Sch+15a], or the 4
paras.zh: 前面章节中的替代损失可以通过对典型策略梯度实现进行微小修改来计算和求导。对于使用自动微分的实现，只需构造损失 \(L^{CLIP}\) 或 \(L^{KLPEN}\) 而非 \(L^{PG}\)，并对该目标执行多个随机梯度上升步骤。大多数计算方差缩减优势函数估计器的技术都使用学习到的状态值函数 \(V(s)\)；例如，广义优势估计 [Sch+15a] 或 4

paras.en: finite-horizon estimators in [Mni+16]. If using a neural network architecture that shares parameters between the policy and value function, we must use a loss function that combines the policy surrogate and a value function error term. This objective can further be augmented by adding an entropy bonus to ensure sufficient exploration, as suggested in past work [Wil92; Mni+16]. Combining these terms, we obtain the following objective, which is (approximately) maximized each iteration: \[ L^{CLIP}(\theta) = \hat{E}_t [ L^{CLIP}(\theta) - c_1 L^{VF}_t(\theta) + c_2 S[\pi_\theta](s_t) ] \, (9) where \(c_1, c_2\) are coefficients, and \(S\) denotes an entropy bonus, and \(L^{VF}_t\) is a squared-error loss \((V_\theta(s_t) - V_t^{\text{targ}})^2\). One style of policy gradient implementation, popularized in [Mni+16] and well-suited for use with recurrent neural networks, runs the policy for \(T\) timesteps (where \(T\) is much less than the episode length), and uses the collected samples for an update. This style requires an advantage estimator that does not look beyond timestep \(T\). The estimator used by [Mni+16] is \( \hat{A}_t = -V(s_t) + r_t + \gamma r_{t+1} + \cdots + \gamma^{T-t+1} r_{T-1} + \gamma^{T-t} V(s_T) \)
paras.zh: [Mni+16]中的有限视界估计器。如果使用在策略和值函数之间共享参数的神经网络架构，我们必须使用一个结合了策略替代和值函数误差项的损失函数。该目标可以通过添加熵奖励来进一步增强，以确保充分的探索，如以往工作[Wil92; Mni+16]所建议的。结合这些项，我们得到以下目标，每次迭代（近似）最大化：\[ L^{CLIP}(\theta) = \hat{E}_t [ L^{CLIP}(\theta) - c_1 L^{VF}_t(\theta) + c_2 S[\pi_\theta](s_t) ] \, (9) 其中 \(c_1, c_2\) 是系数，\(S\) 表示熵奖励，\(L^{VF}_t\) 是平方误差损失 \((V_\theta(s_t) - V_t^{\text{targ}})^2\)。一种在[Mni+16]中推广并非常适合循环神经网络的策略梯度实现风格，运行策略 \(T\) 个时间步（其中 \(T\) 远小于回合长度），并使用收集的样本进行一次更新。这种风格需要一个不超越时间步 \(T\) 的优势估计器。[Mni+16]使用的估计器是 \( \hat{A}_t = -V(s_t) + r_t + \gamma r_{t+1} + \cdots + \gamma^{T-t+1} r_{T-1} + \gamma^{T-t} V(s_T) \)

paras.en: where \(t\) specifies the time index in \([0, T]\), within a given length-\(T\) trajectory segment. Generalizing this choice, we can use a truncated version of generalized advantage estimation, which reduces to Equation (10) when \(\lambda = 1\): \( \hat{A}_t = \delta_t + (\gamma\lambda)\delta_{t+1} + \cdots + (\gamma\lambda)^{T-t+1}\delta_{T-1} \), where \( \delta_t = r_t + \gamma V(s_{t+1}) - V(s_t) \)
paras.zh: 其中 \(t\) 指定 \([0, T]\) 内的时间索引，位于给定长度为 \(T\) 的轨迹段内。推广此选择，我们可以使用广义优势估计的截断版本，当 \(\lambda = 1\) 时，它简化为方程 (10)：\( \hat{A}_t = \delta_t + (\gamma\lambda)\delta_{t+1} + \cdots + (\gamma\lambda)^{T-t+1}\delta_{T-1} \)，其中 \( \delta_t = r_t + \gamma V(s_{t+1}) - V(s_t) \)

paras.en: A proximal policy optimization (PPO) algorithm that uses fixed-length trajectory segments is shown below. Each iteration, each of N (parallel) actors collect T timesteps of data. Then we construct the surrogate loss on these N T timesteps of data, and optimize it with minibatch SGD (or usually for better performance, Adam [KB14]), for K epochs. Algorithm 1 PPO, Actor-Critic Style for iteration=1, 2, . . . do for actor=1, 2, . . . , N do Run policy \π_{θ_{\text{old}}}\ in environment for T timesteps Compute advantage estimates \\hat{A}_1, \ldots, \hat{A}_T\ end for Optimize surrogate L wrt θ, with K epochs and minibatch size M ≤ N T \θ_{\text{old}} \leftarrow θ\ end for
paras.zh: 下面给出了一种使用固定长度轨迹段的近端策略优化（PPO）算法。每次迭代中，N个（并行的）智能体各自收集T个时间步的数据。然后，我们在这NT个时间步的数据上构建替代损失，并使用小批量SGD（通常为获得更好性能，使用Adam [KB14]）对其进行优化，共K个周期。算法1 PPO，Actor-Critic风格：for iteration=1, 2, ... do for actor=1, 2, ..., N do 在环境中执行策略\π_{θ_{\text{old}}}\ T个时间步；计算优势估计\\hat{A}_1, \ldots, \hat{A}_T\；end for 用K个周期和小批量大小M ≤ NT优化关于θ的替代损失L；\θ_{\text{old}} \leftarrow θ\；end for

paras.en: First, we compare several different surrogate objectives under different hyperparameters. Here, we compare the surrogate objective L^{CLIP} to several natural variations and ablated versions. No clipping or penalty:
paras.zh: 首先，我们比较不同超参数下的几种不同替代目标。这里，我们将替代目标L^{CLIP}与几种自然变体和消融版本进行比较。无裁剪或惩罚：

paras.en: For the KL penalty, one can either use a fixed penalty coefficient β or an adaptive coefficient as described in Section 4 using target KL value d_{targ}. Note that we also tried clipping in log space, but found the performance to be no better. Because we are searching over hyperparameters for each algorithm variant, we chose a computationally cheap benchmark to test the algorithms on. Namely, we used 7 simulated robotics tasks² implemented in OpenAI Gym [Bro+16], which use the MuJoCo [TET12] physics engine. We do one million timesteps of training on each one. Besides the hyperparameters used for clipping (\\epsilon\) and the KL penalty (β, d_{targ}), which we search over, the other hyperparameters are provided in Table 3. To represent the policy, we used a fully-connected MLP with two hidden layers of 64 units, and tanh nonlinearities, outputting the mean of a Gaussian distribution, with variable standard deviations, following [Sch+15b; Dua+16]. We don’t share parameters between the policy and value function (so coefficient c1 is irrelevant), and we don’t use an entropy bonus. Each algorithm was run on all 7 environments, with 3 random seeds on each. We scored each run of the algorithm by computing the average total reward of the last 100 episodes. We shifted and scaled the scores for each environment so that the random policy gave a score of 0 and the best result was set to 1, and averaged over 21 runs to produce a single scalar for each algorithm setting. The results are shown in Table 1. Note that the score is negative for the setting without clipping or penalties, because for one environment (half cheetah) it leads to a very negative score, which is worse than the initial random policy. algorithm
paras.zh: 对于KL惩罚，可以使用固定的惩罚系数β或如第4节所述使用目标KL值d_{targ}的自适应系数。注意，我们还尝试了对数空间的裁剪，但发现性能没有更好。由于我们要为每种算法变体搜索超参数，我们选择了一个计算成本较低的基准来测试算法。具体来说，我们使用了OpenAI Gym [Bro+16]中实现的7个模拟机器人任务²，这些任务使用MuJoCo [TET12]物理引擎。我们在每个任务上进行了一百万时间步的训练。除了我们搜索的裁剪超参数（\\epsilon\）和KL惩罚超参数（β, d_{targ}）外，其他超参数见表3。为了表示策略，我们使用了具有两个隐藏层（每层64个单元）和tanh非线性的全连接MLP，输出高斯分布的均值（具有可变标准差），遵循[Sch+15b; Dua+16]。我们不共享策略和价值函数的参数（因此系数c1不相关），也不使用熵奖励。每种算法在所有7个环境中运行，每个环境3个随机种子。我们通过计算最后100个episodes的平均总回报来对每次算法运行进行评分。我们对每个环境的分数进行平移和缩放，使得随机策略的分数为0，最佳结果设为1，然后在21次运行上取平均，为每种算法设置产生一个标量。结果见表1。注意，对于没有裁剪或惩罚的设置，分数为负，因为在一个环境（半猎豹）中它导致非常负的分数，比初始随机策略还差。算法

For PPO, we used the hyperparameters from the previous section, with epsilon = 0.2. We see that PPO outperforms the previous methods on almost all the continuous control environments. HalfCheetah-v1

paras.en: Showcase in the Continuous Domain: Humanoid Running and Steering
paras.zh: 连续域中的展示：人形机器人奔跑与转向

paras.en: To showcase the performance of PPO on high-dimensional continuous control problems, we train on a set of problems involving a 3D humanoid, where the robot must run, steer, and get up off the ground, possibly while being pelted by cubes. The three tasks we test on are (1) RoboschoolHumanoid: forward locomotion only, (2) RoboschoolHumanoidFlagrun: position of target is randomly varied every 200 timesteps or whenever the goal is reached, (3) RoboschoolHumanoidFlagrunHarder, where the robot is pelted by cubes and needs to get up off the ground. See Figure 5 for still frames of a learned policy, and Figure 4 for learning curves on the three tasks. Hyperparameters are provided in Table 4. In concurrent work, Heess et al. [Hee+17] used the adaptive KL variant of PPO (Section 4) to learn locomotion policies for 3D robots. RoboschoolHumanoid-v0
paras.zh: 为了展示PPO在高维连续控制问题上的性能，我们在涉及3D人形机器人的一组问题上进行训练，机器人必须奔跑、转向和从地面站起，可能同时被立方体投掷。我们测试的三个任务是：(1) RoboschoolHumanoid：仅向前运动；(2) RoboschoolHumanoidFlagrun：目标位置每200个时间步或每当达到目标时随机变化；(3) RoboschoolHumanoidFlagrunHarder：机器人被立方体投掷且需要从地面站起。学习策略的静态帧见图5，三个任务的学习曲线见图4。超参数见表4。在同期工作中，Heess等人[Hee+17]使用了PPO的自适应KL变体（第4节）来学习3D机器人的运动策略。RoboschoolHumanoid-v0

paras.en: We also ran PPO on the Arcade Learning Environment [Bel+15] benchmark and compared against well-tuned implementations of A2C [Mni+16] and ACER [Wan+16]. For all three algorithms, we used the same policy network architecture as used in [Mni+16]. The hyperparameters for PPO are provided in Table 5. For the other two algorithms, we used hyperparameters that were tuned to maximize performance on this benchmark. A table of results and learning curves for all 49 games is provided in Appendix B. We consider the following two scoring metrics: (1) average reward per episode over entire training period (which favors fast learning), and (2) average reward per episode over last 100 episodes of training (which favors final performance). Table 2 shows the number of games “won” by each algorithm, where we compute the victor by averaging the scoring metric across three trials.
paras.zh: 我们还在Arcade学习环境[Bel+15]基准上运行了PPO，并与A2C[Mni+16]和ACER[Wan+16]的优化实现进行了比较。对于所有三种算法，我们使用了与[Mni+16]中相同的策略网络架构。PPO的超参数见表5。对于其他两种算法，我们使用了经过调优以最大化该基准性能的超参数。所有49个游戏的结果表格和学习曲线见附录B。我们考虑以下两个评分指标：(1) 整个训练期间的平均每回合奖励（有利于快速学习），(2) 训练最后100个回合的平均每回合奖励（有利于最终性能）。表2显示了每个算法“赢得”的游戏数量，其中我们通过对三个试验的评分指标取平均来计算获胜者。

paras.en: (1) avg. episode reward over all of training (2) avg. episode reward over last 100 episodes
paras.zh: (1) 整个训练期间的平均每回合奖励 (2) 训练最后100个回合的平均每回合奖励

paras.en: We have introduced proximal policy optimization, a family of policy optimization methods that use multiple epochs of stochastic gradient ascent to perform each policy update. These methods have the stability and reliability of trust-region methods but are much simpler to implement, requiring only few lines of code change to a vanilla policy gradient implementation, applicable in more general settings (for example, when using a joint architecture for the policy and value function), and have better overall performance.
paras.zh: 我们介绍了近端策略优化（proximal policy optimization），这是一类使用多轮随机梯度上升来执行每次策略更新的策略优化方法。这些方法具有信任区域方法的稳定性和可靠性，但实现起来更简单，只需要对标准策略梯度实现进行几行代码更改，适用于更一般的设置（例如，当使用策略和价值函数的联合架构时），并且具有更好的整体性能。
